clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Honors Nineteen New National Hero Figures
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto bestowed the National Hero title upon 19 individuals in a ceremony at the State Palace.
Among the recipients recognized for their contributions are former police chief Hoegeng Iman Santoso and military commander Mochammad Sroedji.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Considers Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has communicated his intention to resign to President Prabowo Subianto.
Political leaders are calling for the resignation to follow formal constitutional mechanisms while others suggest it is preferable to impeachment.

clusters.headline: Authorities Detain Over One Hundred Following Yogyakarta Protests
aiSummaryBullets: Police detained 154 individuals following reports of property damage and anarchic behavior at the Yogyakarta Regional House of Representatives.
The demonstration coincided with National Heroes Day and featured various societal groups, including students and civil society representatives.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Discharge Senior Officer Over Illegal Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police dismissed Irjen Ahrie Sonta after an ethics committee found him guilty of unauthorized wiretapping.
The investigation concluded that the former official committed professional misconduct regarding the surveillance of the President.

clusters.headline: Government Officials Deny Presidential Advice Regarding Legal Case
aiSummaryBullets: Head of Indonesian Government Communications Syahganda Nainggolan denied claims that President Prabowo advised Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka to contest diploma issues in court.
Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka previously stated an intention to pursue legal action at the Administrative Court (PTUN) to verify his high school diploma.

clusters.headline: Government Officials Distribute Aid And Visit Sites In Nagan Raya
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian provided heavy machinery and firefighting pumps to support disaster recovery efforts.
The Minister of Social Affairs conducted a review and expressed appreciation for the operational status of local schools.

clusters.headline: Sohibul Iman Appointed As Successor To MPR Deputy Hidayat Nur Wahid
aiSummaryBullets: Hidayat Nur Wahid has stepped down from his role as Deputy Speaker of the People's Consultative Assembly.
The Prosperous Justice Party has officially appointed Mohamad Sohibul Iman to fill the resulting vacancy.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Invalidates Education Certificate For Gibran Rakabuming
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court issued a final ruling invalidating the education equivalence certificate for Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Legal experts indicate that the Supreme Court's decision is binding and no further legal remedies are available to appeal the ruling.

clusters.headline: Indonesian National Police To Conduct Ethics Hearing For Listyo Sigit
aiSummaryBullets: Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit is set to undergo an ethics hearing concerning his involvement in an illegal wiretapping case.
A special task force has been established by the police to investigate allegations of treason and illegal surveillance against President Prabowo.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Advance Opinion Rights Regarding Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Fifty members of the Indonesian House of Representatives have formally signed a proposal to initiate an opinion rights procedure concerning the Vice President.
Parliamentary leadership has acknowledged the petition while confirming they respect parallel legal proceedings currently underway at the Administrative Court.
